title: coelogyne alboviridis
intro: Coelogyne alboviridis, commonly known as the white-green orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The plant is also believed to have therapeutic actions such as anti-anxiety, anti-depressant, and anti-inflammatory properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
